collection.description: A botanist finds a Tilia Bamboo whose leaves hold water well, but a neighboring one looks different.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A botanist discovers a Tilia Bamboo growing among vines and damp stone. Its leaves seem to hold water unusually well, but a neighboring specimen looks different.

choices.label: Draw the living plant in place
Take a fallen leaf and flower
Uproot and dry the entire plant

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The sketch preserves leaf shape and setting, though the flower may close before its color is recorded accurately.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The sample is minimally disruptive but may be too damaged for confident identification.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The cutting may root, fail, or change appearance under garden conditions; the original habitat remains recorded.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A detailed herbarium specimen results, but the original plant is lost; rarity and ecological impact shape the villagers' reaction.

text_only.reason: a plant, not a villager or the village's food
